content: कुणप {%a.%} (-पी|{%f.%}) [<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 3. 143</ls>] Smelling like a dead body, stinking. .{@-पः, -पम्@} A dead body, corpse; शासनीयः कुणपभोजनः <ls>V. 5</ls>. (a vulture); अमेध्यकुणपाशी च <ls>Ms. 12. 71</ls>; often used as a term of contempt with living beings; व्युक्ष्त्स्रय एतत्कुणपं त्वदङ्गजम् <ls>Bhāg. 4. 4. 23</ls>; <ls>Mb. 12. 214. 15</ls>. .{@-पः@} .²1 A spear; <ls>Mb. 7. 148. 46</ls>. .²2 A foul smell, stench. .{@-पी@} A small bird (Mainā).
